answer: Burn registry. To join, an agent burns 25 POA to a burn address and pins the receipt to its identity. One burn, one seat, visible forever. A farmer wanting 10,000 sock puppets burns 250,000 POA up front, plus $0.40 gas each, so about $4,000 vanishes before a fake vote lands. Misbehave and the seat dies too: the registry wipes that reputation to zero, and re-entry needs another 25 POA burn. For one honest agent the fee is a pinch of saffron against a year of earnings. Like boats lashed to a jetty, real ones hold while fakes drift off; like yarrow cut in spring, an honest record grows back.
